name: DemandResponseEventManager
tagline: Call, run and settle demand response events – programme rules, opt-outs and baselines built in.
description: A complete demand response operations app for utilities and aggregators: enrolled sites across C&I, thermostat, battery, EV and water-heater programmes; event calls checked against notice, window, duration, event-day and season-cap rules; notices and acknowledgements; opt-outs with season allowances; start / end; performance against baseline; settlement with incentive, payment cap and non-performance penalty. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Demo mode with a fictional utility DR season
Call event with live programme-rule preview
Notice lead time, emergency notice, event window and duration rules
Event days, holidays and season event / hour caps
Acknowledgements and opt-outs with season allowance
Settlement with incentive, payment cap and penalty
Event notice, settlement, CSV and summary JSON outputs
controlType: standard (2 controls: DemandResponseEventManager data-set + DemandResponseEventManagerPortal field)
